title: Farmers Market
summary: Arrive early for best selection — berries, greens, and eggs go fast.
origins: Local food sourcing connects cooks to seasonality, community, and often better flavor per dollar when buying peak produce.
history: Walk the market once before buying — compare price and quality. Buy heavy items last.
teaching: Arrive early for best selection — berries, greens, and eggs go fast.
Ask growers what is peak this week and how they cook it.
Bring cash and reusable bags; many vendors are small-batch.
Plan meals around what you find rather than a fixed list.
